newsitem.title: UK: Harvey Nichols retail sales up 19 pct.
newsitem.headline: Harvey Nichols retail sales up 19 pct.

text.p: British luxury department store Harvey Nichols Group Plc said on Wednesday that cumulative sales for the first 18 weeks of the current financial year for the retail stores were 19 percent up on the same period last year.
Announcing this at the company's annual meeting, deputy chairman John Gray said the company's Knightsbridge store accounted for the 6.5 percent of this increase.
The company's share price had touched a day's high of 240-1/2 pence but at 1355 GMT it was down at 237-1/2, 4-1/2 pence lower than Tuesday's close.
